definitions.explanation: A band worn around the neck of a dog, cat, or other animal, often for identification or to attach a leash.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{首輪|くびわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I put a collar on the dog.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{首輪|くびわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}かけた→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧。
examples.english: I spotted a cat wearing a red collar.

examples.japanese: {首輪|くびわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{電話番号|でんわばんごう}→電話番号：10159_denwabangou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}いてあった→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{飼|か}い{主|ぬし}→飼い主：15281_kainushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The collar had a name and phone number on it, so I was able to contact the owner.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧ (neck) + ⟦{輪|わ}→輪：02142_wa⟧ (ring/band). Refers almost exclusively to animal collars in modern Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {首輪|くびわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to put on a collar
- {首輪|くびわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to take off a collar
- {首輪|くびわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧: a dog wearing a collar
- {首輪|くびわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名札|なふだ}→名札：12338_nafuda⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to attach a name tag to a collar

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ネックレス→ネックレス：04539_nekkuresu⟧: necklace (for people — jewelry)
- ⟦リード→リード：11601_riido⟧/{引|ひ}き{綱|づな}: leash (often attached to the {首輪|くびわ})
- ハーネス: harness (alternative to collar for dogs)

USAGE:
In modern Japanese, {首輪|くびわ} is not used for human jewelry. Saying someone has a {首輪|くびわ} metaphorically implies being controlled or restrained.
